subject.title: Bug: Cron fallback chain broken — models return zero-token success or killed by shared AbortController

question: Should this issue remain open until a current-main or post-fix release reproduction proves the remaining shared-deadline abort or cron session model persistence symptom?
rationale: The zero-result classifier root cause is implemented on main, but the latest maintainer comment intentionally left the issue open because the other claimed symptoms were not independently proven after that fix.

options.title: Keep Open For Fresh Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for configured timeout, per-attempt timestamps, abort reason/time, and resulting session model fields before scheduling another fix.

options.title: Close As Classifier-Fixed
options.body: Close only the returned-result part as fixed on main and ask reporters to file a new issue if the abort or persistence symptom reproduces after the fix ships.

options.title: Route To Timeout PR
options.body: Treat the timeout-budget PR as the remaining canonical path, but require its conflict/proof blockers to be cleared before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Fresh Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for configured timeout, per-attempt timestamps, abort reason/time, and resulting session model fields before scheduling another fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete posted the current maintainer assessment and authored the merged classifier fix that changed the issue state.
